Neutralized Venom Clot is a crafting reagent exclusive to the Coiled Isle. It can be obtained by walking into the tiny green orbs that spawn after the venom has been drained from Envenomated Tranquility Bloom and Envenomated Copper, and they can also be skinned from animals. They only appear in areas where a Curse Surge has recently been defeated.

Niffen Strong-Sniffer Stout is obtained from Kritha for A Disquieting Feeling.

Night Elven Shield is looted from the Kaldorei Shield in Bel'ameth in Amirdrassil.

The Nibelgaz Mine is an abandoned mine in the northeastern corner of the Ringing Deeps. It is bordered by the Earthenworks to the west.

News From Below concludes the third chapter of the max-level The War Within (achievement) campaign. The storyline immediately continues with A Mysterious Signal.

Night-Twisted Berserkers are dire orcs located in the Market District in Highmaul.

Nexus-Point Xenas is a dungeon in . It will have adventurers cut through a fortress pulsing with unstable Void energy, a point in which the campaign reaches a boiling point. The dungeon is unlocked by reaching level 90 or speaking to Alleria during the quest Nexus-Point Xenas: Eclipse.
Niffen Smell Pouch is a trash item found in the Niffen Stash in Azj-Kahet. It can also sometimes be looted from chests at the end of completed delves from .

Night-Twisted Pales are pale orcs that attack Highmaul continuously in large numbers by jumping over the eastern gate. They are then slaughtered by two ogres. After these ogres are dead, they will stop spawning. They are untargetable, but their name shows up in the tooltip when mousing over them.

Night-Twisted Cadavers are pale orcs that spawn during The Butcher encounter at the Underbelly in Highmaul on Mythic difficulty. They will walk towards The Butcher, and will explode upon either reaching him or walking near a player, leaving behind a pool of Pale Vitriol for the rest of the encounter. They also spawn upon approaching The Butcher for the first time in a run, and they will quickly be killed by him.
Night-Twisted Earthwarpers are pale orcs that spawn during the Tectus encounter at the Market District in Highmaul.
Night-Twisted Faithful are pale orcs that are spawned by during the last phase of the Imperator Mar'gok encounter at the Throne of the Imperator in Highmaul on Mythic difficulty.
Nibbles' Training Rod drops from Kystia Manaheart in Murder Row.

Night's Embrace is a special consumable item sold by Hospitus only to void elves for . It gives the Void elf player a buff for 30 minutes to a void form, the same effect that can be seen when Entropic Embrace procs.

Nightmare Incursions are PvE events that occur near the Emerald Dream portals in , , , and the . They involve battling mobs both near the portals and traversing the portals to kill enemies, gather resources, or defeat bosses within. Participating in Nightmare Incursions will earn reputation with the Emerald Wardens. The Duskwood incursion is level 25, the Ashenvale incursion is level 40, and the Feralas and Hinterlands incursions are level 50. Traversing an Emerald Dream portal gives the character the buff and allows them to explore the familiar zone with new Dream-like qualities. Large, translucent foliage grows everywhere, and the creatures within are similar to their real-world versions w

The Nightcloak Sanctum is the penultimate area in Castle Nathria and serves as the site for the first phase of the Sire Denathrius boss fight.
Nightfall Sanctum is a delve located at the Veneration Grounds in Hallowfall.
Nightcaller Velys is an Arathi found in Priory of the Sacred Flame during A Light in the Dark.

Nightfall Skyreaver's Reins teach the Nightfall Skyreaver, a rylak mount. This item can be purchased for 5,000 from in Stormshield or in Warspear during the Warlords of Draenor timewalking event.

The Nightmare Grove is a raid instance allowing combat with the world bosses in an instanced format. Players can enter the raid at any of the four portals in , , , or the . The portal used determines which boss is fought first; after defeating it, a portal will appear to allow direct access to the next dragon. With hotfixes during Phase 7, the Nightmare Grove was adjusted to be a "catch up" raid, dropping set pieces and recipes from and the .

Nightfall Sanctum Campsite is available from Reno Jackson at the Delver's Headquarters in Dornogal for 10x Resonance Crystals after completing the Delver's Journey during The War Within Season 2. It unlocks the "Cultists' Quay" campsite. In The War Within Season 3 and beyond, Sir Finley Mrrgglton sells it for 10,000 Undercoin.

The Nightfall scenario is a public scenario in the vein of the Theater Troupe that takes place at at Morgaen's Tears in southwestern Hallowfall hourly at the top of the hour (at xx:00). There's no lockout — it can be run as often as desired. Participate in the scenario alongside other players to gain reputation with the Flame's Radiance and earn loot and achievements.

The adventurer-track version of this item is BoP and only available from the vendor. BoE explorer-track versions of this item can be found in Confiscated Cultist's Bag and from the boss that spawns at the end of the Nightfall scenario. A veteran-track 668 version has a chance to drop from Radiant Service Satchel.
